Glen Echo Loops (C pace)

Glen Echo, MD · Road

Glen Echo Loops (C pace) is a road group ride in Glen Echo, MD. It rolls every Thursday at 10:00 am from Glen Echo, MD.

For visitors

All riders must register each week, and download the RideWithGPS route that is posted at least two days ahead. Potomac Pedalers is a membership club; check its 'Ride with us' page for guest rules.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11-12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Glen Echo Loops (C pace) group ride

A weekly Thursday-morning C-pace ride of 25 to 30 miles through low-traffic, moderately hilly residential roads, often through Potomac Village. The group rides together at 11-12 mph with a midway rest stop. A faster B/BB version leaves a little earlier.
